purpose: descriptive comparison of SMARTIAN with existing C1 results
observations: All three existing C1 Echidna methods and SMARTIAN found the property violation in 30/30 runs for both targets.
SMARTIAN used a 30-second timelimit and has no public seed option; C1 uses Echidna testLimit 100000, timeout 30, and seeds 1-30.
SMARTIAN process wall time and Echidna fuzz_seconds are not equal-work timing measures and must not be interpreted as speedup.
interpretation: This is a tool-availability and oracle-aligned descriptive baseline, not evidence that SMARTIAN is superior to Echidna or to the proposed method.
